market_radar_latency.description: Market Radar is served from bounded local projection within its SLO

http_disconnect_resilience.description: Client disconnect does not create double-response/worker failure

postgres_transaction_resilience.description: Injected/transient PostgreSQL failure rolls back/fails closed and authority recovers

persistence_telemetry.description: System-health foreground read is bounded, background physical telemetry converges, and the completed health projection is fast/restart-safe

lake_reconciliation.description: Durable lake/Parquet reconciliation is complete before any destructive/prune step

operational_evidence_chain.description: Operational evidence hash chain has no source failures or chain errors

scanner_terminality.description: Scanner completes bounded generations with coherent population/stage accounting

canonical_surface_reconciliation.description: Canonical DecisionRecord reconciles Today Entries, Ledger and Model Paper without conflicts/orphans

signal_ledger_authority.description: Signal Ledger health derives from canonical accepted/settled decision authority

research_readiness_separation.description: Research runtime readiness is distinct from model/research evidence readiness

worker_progress_truth.description: RUNNING/healthy worker state requires useful-progress evidence or explicit expected-idle

reference_job_nonzero.description: Reference-data job cannot report success with zero required rows

diagnostic_api_contract.description: Installed diagnostics use only registered HTTP methods/routes and return bounded responses

fresh_current_product_evidence.description: Current exact-build browser/API proof covers Market/Sector, Stock Report, Chart, MTF, S/R and Research

operations_live_progress.description: Operations UI exposes live useful-progress/state for active jobs

audited_safe_recovery_action.description: Manual recovery controls are safety-classed, bounded and persisted in audit trail

market_alias_direction_alignment.description: Canonical market/sector names are used and stale direction cannot accompany newer price

operations_log_trail.description: Operations UI/log projection has concrete sources and no object/undefined rendering

performance_geometry_lineage.description: Accuracy/performance uses geometry-complete canonical settlements and authoritative post-cost lineage

research_retention_restart.description: Restart preserves Research evidence content hash/high-water counts without regression

selected_stock_orchestration_isolation.description: Selected-stock usefulness remains available when orchestration lease/controller is stale/unhealthy

scanner_no_retired_generations.description: Retired scanner generations cannot remain active/saturate bounded analysis workers

controller_watchdog.description: Wedged controller evaluation is fenced by bounded watchdog and caller remains responsive

operations_local_projection.description: Operations diagnostics remain bounded local projections when dependencies are unhealthy

settlement_single_authority.description: One canonical settlement authority owns outcome/cost/P&L; no duplicate execution path is active

restart_history_continuity.description: Restart preserves/reuses stored historical rows and final timestamps

browser_stable_dom.description: Core tables/report reuse stable DOM identity during in-place refresh
